newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico coffee farmers win funds for organic plan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico coffee farmers win funds for organic plan.

text.p: Around 900 Mexican coffee farmers from the southern state of Oaxaca have won $50,000 in funds for an organic bean project, the state-owned news agency Notimex said Thursday.

Procuro Pascual Lopez, coordinator for the North American Environmental Cooperation Fund, told Notimex that the growers in the northern sierra of the state had won the funds for a project known as "Organic Coffee from the Cloud Forest".

Pascual Lopez said the growers, belonging to the Association of Organisations of the Sierra Juarez of Oaxaca, would convert to organic coffee farming over the next 20 months by not using chemicals or pesticides on 800 hectares.
Beans from the designated zone will be internationally certified as organic and most probably sold in European markets, he added.
